notes: GAP -> CONFORMS, recorded by the LANDER (see DOC-A.1-165 for why the implementer could not). §14.7.9.3 GR2 requires the implementor to state the internal representation of the SECONDS temporary, the maximum meaningful time-out value, and the technique for determining the frequency of retries. The determination is 9(1)V9(0) (n=1, m=0), maximum meaningful value 0, and no attempts during the timeout period — one rule, not a special case, which is why `RETRY FOR 0 SECONDS` and `RETRY FOR 30 SECONDS` agree. That AGREEMENT is the observable form of the determination and is what the golden pins (DELSC0 / DELSC30 both '62'). GR2's temporary is an implicit COMPUTE WITHOUT ROUNDED — truncation at m — which is a different rule from GR1's round-up on the TIMES count; the two keep separate renderings in RenderRetry.
